During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''customs officer''' reneged on a deal to smuggle arms to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] for a local crime syndicate, and was forced to seek help in escaping the syndicate's retribution.<ref name="TOR" />
